short: A decisive Russian victory that led to the occupation of Finland, known as the Greater Wrath.
full:
The Battle of Storkyro took place on 2 March 1714 in western Finland. A Russian army commanded by Prince Mikhail Golitsyn engaged a smaller Swedish-Finnish force led by General Carl Gustaf Armfeldt. Despite initial Swedish success in repelling Russian attacks, the sheer weight of Russian numbers eventually overwhelmed the defenders in a bloody melee.

The destruction of Armfeldt's army removed the last organized military resistance in Finland. The victory allowed Russian forces to occupy the entirety of the country, initiating a brutal period of occupation and pillaging known in Finnish history as the Greater Wrath (Isoviha), which lasted until the end of the war.
